title: Can Machine Learning Potentials Be More Accurate Than the Methods They Are Trained On?
abstract: arXiv:2610.18027v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Although machine learning potentials (MLPs) generalize across configurational and chemical compound spaces, their accuracy is commonly believed to be limited by their training methods, with improvements beyond this limit achieved so far only by refitting to experimental observables. In this Perspective, we argue that MLPs can also be made more accurate than their training methods non-empirically by generalizing across a third space, that of quantum-chemical methods. We propose routes to method-transferable MLPs that predict at unseen methods, with working implementations in both density-functional and wavefunction-based theories showing that they can be more accurate than any of their training methods. Aiming beyond the accuracy of the training methods could also make universal MLPs more accurate than single-method models, even when the method-transferable MLPs remain less accurate than those QM methods. translated_title: 机器学习势能否比训练它们的方法更准确？
translated_abstract: 尽管机器学习势（MLPs）能够在构型空间和化学化合物空间之间进行泛化，但人们普遍认为其准确性受限于训练它们的方法，迄今为止超越这一限制的改进只能通过重新拟合实验可观测量来实现。在本观点文章中，我们论证了机器学习势也可以通过在第三个空间——量子化学方法空间——上进行泛化，从而以非经验的方式变得比其训练方法更准确。我们提出了构建方法可迁移机器学习势的途径，使其能够在未见过的方法上进行预测，并且在密度泛函理论和波函数理论中的可行实现表明，这类势可以比其任何训练方法都更准确。以超越训练方法的准确性为目标，还可以使通用机器学习势比单方法模型更准确，即使方法可迁移机器学习势的准确性仍低于那些量子力学（QM）方法。方法可迁移机器学习势将……
tldr: 本文提出“方法可迁移机器学习势”的新范式，通过让模型在量子化学方法空间中泛化，能够以非经验的方式实现比其训练方法更高的预测精度，为超越传统精度极限提供了新途径。
en_tdlr: This Perspective proposes method-transferable machine learning potentials that generalize across quantum-chemical methods, enabling MLPs to non-empirically surpass the accuracy of the very methods they were trained on.
